name: 15-gcc-message-language
command: pacman -Qo /usr/share/locale/de/LC_MESSAGES/gcc.mo /usr/share/locale/fr/LC_MESSAGES/gcc.mo; echo "gcc catalogs installed: $(ls /usr/share/locale/*/LC_MESSAGES/gcc.mo | wc -l)"; cat t.cpp; for env in "LANGUAGE=" "LANGUAGE=de" "LANGUAGE=fr" "LANGUAGE=de LC_ALL=C"; do echo "== $env g++ -std=c++17 -fsyntax-only t.cpp"; env $env g++ -std=c++17 -fsyntax-only t.cpp 2>&1 | grep "error:"; done
